title_zh: 双胞胎换座位考验代课老师
title_en: Funny Stories from Life (14/20): Twins Swap Seats to Test the Substitute Teacher
note_en: The passive marker 被 often signals something unwelcome happening to the subject: 果然又被她一眼看穿 "sure enough, she saw right through them again at a glance." The agent (她) comes right after 被, before the verb, while English puts "by her" at the end, or rewrites the sentence in the active voice, as here.

sentences.en: Xiao Long and Xiao Hu ("Little Dragon" and "Little Tiger") were twins who looked almost exactly alike, and ever since they were little, they had loved swapping identities to fool their teachers.

sentences.en: Years later, Xiao Long and Xiao Hu both became teachers. Whenever they caught naughty students up to some little trick in their classes, the two would exchange a smile and say in unison, "We pulled this trick way better than you back in the day. But take our advice and don't try it. Teachers are much smarter than you think."
